source: Live closed-loop Isaac Lab RGB capture with the existing PathDebugVisualizer
scope: Simulation illustration; not a benchmark, hardware recording or wall-clock real-time demonstration
capture_instrumentation: Camera, RGB capture, finite loop and enabling existing visualizer for offscreen rendering; no replacement route geometry or goal computation

gif.time_base: simulated control time, not wall-clock capture time
gif.trim_rule: Prefix through first recorded sample with reference progress >=3.90 m; later playback remains archived locally

photo_note: Close-ups captured in the same live seeded rollout without advancing physics during camera changes; the camera is restored before recording the next GIF frame.
overlays: Native XYZ reference and measured base trace; native orange preview, native yellow target and yaw arrow
yellow_marker: Exact debug_goal_idx computed by visualization_goal_index in play_policy.py; sphere center equals path XYZ at that index, yaw arrow uses the native reference yaw.
goal_validation: All captured goal positions exactly match the native world-reference row at the native goal index; both required heights are retained.
